sentences.en: He doesn't need much of an introduction, but I want to say a couple of things.

sentences.en: And my hope is that we can talk about how he thinks, about his influence, about his power,
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能谈谈他的思维方式、他的影响力、他的权力，

sentences.en: about all of it.

sentences.zh: 我想反诽谤联盟的乔纳森·格林布拉特也在这里。

sentences.zh: 你说什么？

sentences.zh: 不，绝对还有更多内容。

sentences.zh: 但我告诉你一件让我震惊的事。

sentences.en: It wasn't, and I'm an American Jew, it wasn't just the people who had that view.
sentences.zh: 并不是——而且我本人也是美国犹太人——不仅仅是那些持有这种观点的人。

sentences.en: It was actually people who really are anti-Semites, who said, oh my goodness, go Elon.
sentences.zh: 实际上是那些真正的反犹主义者，他们说，天哪，埃隆干得好。

sentences.en: This is fabulous.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: And that actually was the thing that really set me back.
sentences.zh: 而这才是真正让我退缩的事情。

sentences.en: I said to myself, what's going on here?
sentences.zh: 我对自己说，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: And I want to know how you felt about that in that moment, when you saw all of this happening.
sentences.zh: 我想知道在那一刻，当你看到这一切发生时，你是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Well, first of all, I did clarify almost immediately what I meant.
sentences.zh: 好吧，首先，我几乎立刻就澄清了我的意思。

sentences.en: I would say that that was, you know, if I could go back and say I should, in retrospect, not have replied to that particular person,
sentences.zh: 我会说，如果能回到过去，我应该说，回想起来，我不该回复那个人，

sentences.en: and I should have written in greater length as to what I meant.
sentences.zh: 我应该更详细地写出我的意思。

sentences.en: I did subsequently clarify it in replies, but those clarifications were ignored by the media, and essentially I handed a loaded gun to those who hate me,
sentences.zh: 我后来在回复中澄清了，但媒体忽略了这些澄清，本质上我把一把上膛的枪递给了那些恨我的人，

sentences.en: and arguably to those who are anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 也可以说是递给了那些反犹主义者。

sentences.en: And for that, I'm quite sorry.
sentences.zh: 对此，我深表歉意。

sentences.en: That was not my intention.
sentences.zh: 那不是我的本意。

sentences.en: So, I did, you know, post on my primary timeline to be absolutely clear that I'm not anti-Semitic, and that I, in fact, if anything, am philo-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 所以，我确实在我的主时间线上发帖，明确表示我不是反犹主义者，事实上，如果非要说的话，我还是亲犹主义者。

sentences.en: And the trip to Israel was planned before any of that happened.
sentences.zh: 而且去以色列的行程在这一切发生之前就已经计划好了。

sentences.en: It was neither here nor there.
sentences.zh: 那与此无关。

sentences.zh: 你看到这个东西了吗？

sentences.en: Do you know what it is?
sentences.zh: 你知道这是什么吗？

sentences.en: I do, because I actually followed your entire trip to Israel.
sentences.zh: 我知道，因为我确实关注了你整个以色列之行。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Why don't you tell everybody?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不告诉大家呢？

sentences.en: This is, this says, this says, bring them home, the hostages.
sentences.zh: 这上面写着，带他们回家，人质们。

sentences.en: It was given to me by the parents of one of the hostages.
sentences.zh: 这是其中一位人质的父母给我的。

sentences.en: And I said I would wear it as long as there was a hostage store remaining.
sentences.zh: 我说过，只要还有人质被扣押，我就会一直戴着它。

sentences.en: And I have.
sentences.zh: 我做到了。

sentences.en: What was that trip like?
sentences.zh: 那次旅行感觉如何？

sentences.en: And obviously, you know that there's a public perception that that was part of a apology tour, if you will.
sentences.zh: 显然，你知道公众认为那是一次道歉之旅，如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: That this had been said online, there was all of the criticism, there was advertisers leaving.
sentences.zh: 网上出现了那些言论，所有的批评，还有广告商的撤离。

sentences.zh: 我们今天和鲍勃·伊格尔谈过了。

sentences.en: I hope they stop.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们停止。

sentences.en: You hope?
sentences.zh: 你希望？

sentences.en: Don't advertise.
sentences.zh: 别投广告。

sentences.en: You don't want them to advertise?
sentences.zh: 你不希望他们投广告？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: If somebody's going to try to blackmail me with advertising, blackmail me with money, go f*** yourself.
sentences.zh: 如果有人想用广告来勒索我，用钱来勒索我，那就去死吧。

sentences.en: But go f*** yourself.
sentences.zh: 就是去死吧。

sentences.en: Is that clear?
sentences.zh: 这够清楚吗？

sentences.en: I hope it is.
sentences.zh: 我希望是这样。

sentences.zh: 嘿，鲍勃。

sentences.zh: 如果你在观众席里的话。

sentences.en: Well, let me ask you then.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那让我问你。

sentences.en: That's how I feel.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的感受。

sentences.en: Don't advertise.
sentences.zh: 别投广告。

sentences.zh: 那你怎么看待X的经济模式？

sentences.zh: 如果潜在模式的一部分，至少在今天，也许需要改变。

sentences.zh: 也许答案是它需要从广告转向其他模式。

sentences.en: If you believe that this is the one part of your business where you will be beholden to those who have this view, what do you do?
sentences.zh: 如果你认为这是你业务中唯一受制于持有这种观点的人的部分，你该怎么办？

sentences.en: I understand that, but there's a reality, too.
sentences.zh: 我明白这一点，但现实也是如此。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, Linda Yaccarino is right here, and she's got to sell advertising.
sentences.zh: 我是说，琳达·亚卡里诺就在这儿，她必须销售广告。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: So, no, no.
sentences.zh: 所以，不，不。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Actually, what this advertising boycott is going to do, it's going to kill the company.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这次广告抵制将会毁掉这家公司。

sentences.en: And do you think that the company?
sentences.zh: 你认为公司会？

sentences.en: And the whole world will know that those advertisers killed the company, and we will document it in great detail.
sentences.zh: 全世界都会知道是那些广告商毁了这家公司，我们会详细记录下来。

sentences.en: But those advertisers, I imagine, are going to say, they're going to say, we didn't kill the company.
sentences.zh: 但我想那些广告商会说，他们会说，我们没有毁掉公司。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是啊。

sentences.en: They're going to say.
sentences.zh: 他们会这么说的。

sentences.en: Tell it to Earth.
sentences.zh: 去跟地球上的人说吧。

sentences.en: But they're going to say that, they're going to say, Elon, that you killed the company because you said these things, and that they were inappropriate things,
sentences.zh: 但他们会那么说，他们会说，埃隆，是你毁了公司，因为你说了这些话，而且是不恰当的话，

sentences.en: and that they didn't feel comfortable on the platform, right?
sentences.zh: 而且他们在平台上感到不舒服，对吧？

sentences.en: That's what they're going to say.
sentences.zh: 他们会这么说的。

sentences.en: And let's see how Earth responds to that.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看地球对此有何反应。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Then this goes back to.
sentences.zh: 那这就回到了。

sentences.en: We'll both make our cases, and we'll see what the outcome is.
sentences.zh: 我们都会陈述各自的理由，看看结果如何。

sentences.en: What are the economics of that for you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说经济意义是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, you have enormous resources, so you can actually keep this company going for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你拥有巨大的资源，所以你实际上可以让这家公司维持很长时间。

sentences.en: Would you keep it going for a long time if there was no advertising?
sentences.zh: 如果没有广告，你会让它维持很长时间吗？

sentences.en: I mean, if the company fails because of an advertised boycott, it will fail because of an advertised boycott.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果公司因为广告抵制而失败，那它就是因为广告抵制而失败。

sentences.en: And that will be what bankrupt the company, and that's what everyone on Earth will know.
sentences.zh: 那将是导致公司破产的原因，也是地球上每个人都会知道的事实。

sentences.en: What do you think, then, of the idea of trust, though?
sentences.zh: 那你怎么看待信任这个概念呢？

sentences.en: Then it'll be gone.
sentences.zh: 那它就消失了。

sentences.en: And it'll be gone because of an advertised boycott.
sentences.zh: 而且它消失是因为广告抵制。

sentences.en: But you recognize that some of those people are going to say that they didn't feel comfortable on the platform.
sentences.zh: 但你承认有些人会说他们在平台上感到不舒服。

sentences.en: And I just wonder and ask you and think about that for a second.
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇，想问问你，让你思考一下。

sentences.en: Tell it to the judge.
sentences.zh: 去跟法官说吧。

sentences.en: But the judge is going to be.
sentences.zh: 但法官将会是。

sentences.en: The judge is the public.
sentences.zh: 法官是公众。

sentences.en: And you think that the public is going to say that Disney is making a mistake?
sentences.zh: 你认为公众会说迪士尼犯了错吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And they're going to boycott Disney?
sentences.zh: 他们会抵制迪士尼吗？

sentences.en: They already are.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在抵制了。

sentences.en: Well, there are some that are for lots of different reasons.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有些人是因为各种不同的原因。

sentences.en: But you think that this is going to.
sentences.zh: 但你认为这将会。

sentences.en: That you have.
sentences.zh: 你有。

sentences.en: This goes to actually the interesting of power and leverage.
sentences.zh: 这实际上触及了权力和杠杆作用的有趣之处。

sentences.en: Let the chips fall where they may.
sentences.zh: 顺其自然吧。

sentences.en: Let the chips fall where they may.
sentences.zh: 顺其自然吧。

sentences.en: Can I ask why that is the approach?
sentences.zh: 我可以问问为什么采取这种方式吗？

sentences.en: I ask it because you've been.
sentences.zh: 我这么问是因为你一直。

sentences.en: What's the other approach?
sentences.zh: 还有什么别的方法吗？

sentences.en: Well, you've been very particular about the approach to Tesla.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你对特斯拉的处理方式非常讲究。

sentences.en: When you think about the engineering involved in that.
sentences.zh: 当你思考其中涉及的工程问题时。

sentences.en: The approach to SpaceX.
sentences.zh: SpaceX的处理方式。

sentences.en: The approach to some of the stuff you're doing with AI has been very specific.
sentences.zh: 你处理人工智能的一些方式也非常具体。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: There's not a let the chips fall where they may approach to those businesses.
sentences.zh: 那些业务并没有采取顺其自然的方式。

sentences.en: I don't think.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得。

sentences.en: No, we focus on making the best products.
sentences.zh: 不，我们专注于制造最好的产品。

sentences.en: And Tesla has gotten to where it's gotten with no advertising at all.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉在没有任何广告的情况下走到了今天。

sentences.en: Well, I understand that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我明白这一点。

sentences.en: Tesla currently sells to twice as much in terms of electric vehicles as the rest of electric car makers in the United States combined.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉目前的电动汽车销量是美国其他所有电动汽车制造商总和的两倍。

sentences.en: Tesla has done more to help the environment than all other companies combined.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉在保护环境方面所做的贡献超过了所有其他公司的总和。

sentences.en: It would be fair to say that, therefore, as a leader of the company, I've done more for the environment than any single human on Earth.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为公司的领导者，我可以公平地说，我为环境所做的贡献超过了地球上的任何一个人。

sentences.en: How do you feel about that?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何感想？

sentences.en: How do I feel about that?
sentences.zh: 我对此有何感想？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: No, I'm asking you personally how you feel about that.
sentences.zh: 不，我是问你个人对此有何感想。

sentences.en: Because this goes.
sentences.zh: 因为这事关重大。

sentences.en: We're talking about power and influence.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是权力和影响力。

sentences.en: I'm saying what I care about is the reality of goodness, not the perception of it.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，我关心的是善良的本质，而不是善良的表象。

sentences.en: And what I see all over the place is people who care about looking good while doing evil.
sentences.zh: 我到处看到的是那些一边作恶一边还要装作善良的人。

sentences.en: F**k them.
sentences.zh: 去他们的。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: Let me ask you this, because I think part of this, by the way, there's some people who have said, look, owning X to begin with has just created probleMs.
sentences.zh: 让我问你这个问题，因为我认为这其中有一部分原因，顺便说一下，有些人说，看，拥有 X 本身就制造了问题。

sentences.en: That you've created so many amazing things that are changing our world.
sentences.zh: 你创造了这么多改变我们世界的了不起的东西。

sentences.en: And I know you want to make X, this fabulous town square free speech platform, but that unto itself, that that has created such a distraction of all of these things.
sentences.zh: 我知道你想把 X 打造成一个绝佳的城市广场式的言论自由平台，但这件事本身，已经造成了所有这些事情的干扰。

sentences.en: This is the conversation we're having.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们正在进行的对话。

sentences.en: We're not focused.
sentences.zh: 我们没有聚焦。

sentences.en: We're not talking at least yet.
sentences.zh: 我们至少还没谈到重点。

sentences.en: And we will.
sentences.zh: 我们会谈到的。

sentences.en: On Tesla, you have your Cybertruck deliveries tomorrow and everything else that you're doing.
sentences.zh: 关于特斯拉，你明天要交付 Cybertruck，还有你正在做的其他一切事情。

sentences.en: But is there any.
sentences.zh: 但是有没有……

sentences.en: It will be the biggest product launch of anything by far on Earth this year.
sentences.zh: 这将是今年地球上规模最大的产品发布会，遥遥领先于其他任何产品。

sentences.en: Is there any part of you, though, that just says, you know what?
sentences.zh: 不过，你内心深处有没有哪怕一点点想法，觉得，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I just shouldn't have done this.
sentences.zh: 我真不该这么做。

sentences.en: Or maybe I should sell it or give it away or do something else with the X piece of it.
sentences.zh: 或者也许我应该把它卖掉、送人，或者用 X 做点别的什么。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Given the propensity for some of the things that you do and say on that platform to create these issues.
sentences.zh: 考虑到你在那个平台上所做和所说的一些事情容易引发这些问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Of all the posts I've done on the platform, I think there might be 30,000 or something like that.
sentences.zh: 在我发布的所有帖子中，我想可能有三万条左右吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Once in a while, I will say something foolish.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，我会说些蠢话。

sentences.en: And I have.
sentences.zh: 我也确实说过。

sentences.en: And I would certainly put that comment, that you've said the actual truth, among perhaps one of the most foolish, if not the most foolish thing I've ever done on the platform.
sentences.zh: 我当然会把那条评论——你说那是事实——归为我在这平台上做过的最愚蠢的事情之一，如果不是最愚蠢的话。

sentences.en: And I did do my best to clarify afterwards that I certainly don't mean anything anti-Semitic in that.
sentences.zh: 事后我也尽力澄清了，我绝对没有任何反犹太主义的意思。

sentences.en: The nature of the criticism was simply that the Jewish people have been persecuted for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 批评的本质仅仅是犹太民族几千年来一直受到迫害。

sentences.en: There is a natural affinity, therefore, for persecuted groups.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们对受迫害的群体有一种天然的亲近感。

sentences.en: This has led to the funding of organizations that essentially promote any persecuted group or any group with the perception of persecution.
sentences.zh: 这导致了对一些组织的资助，这些组织本质上是在推广任何受迫害的群体，或者任何被认为受到迫害的群体。

sentences.en: This includes radical Islamic groups.
sentences.zh: 这包括激进的伊斯兰组织。

sentences.en: Everyone here has seen the massive demonstrations for Hamas in every major city in the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 在座的各位都看到了西方各大城市为哈马斯举行的声势浩大的示威活动。

sentences.en: That should be jarring.
sentences.zh: 那应该让人感到不安。

sentences.en: Well, a number of those organizations received funding from prominent people in the Jewish community.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中一些组织确实收到了犹太社区知名人士的资助。

sentences.en: They didn't expect that to happen.
sentences.zh: 他们没料到会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: But if you generically, without condition, if you fund persecuted groups, in general, some of those persecuted groups, unfortunately, want your annihilation.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不加条件地资助受迫害群体，总的来说，不幸的是，其中一些受迫害群体想要你的命。

sentences.en: And what I meant by that, when I subsequently clarified this, is that it's unwise to fund organizations that support groups that want your annihilation.
sentences.zh: 我后来澄清时想表达的意思是，资助那些支持想要你命的群体的组织是不明智的。

sentences.en: Is this coming across clearly?
sentences.zh: 这表达清楚了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, no, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，清楚了。

sentences.en: My question to you, though, is...
sentences.zh: 不过，我想问你的是……

sentences.en: I think logically this makes a lot of sense.
sentences.zh: 我认为从逻辑上讲，这很有道理。

sentences.en: Is there any part of you...
sentences.zh: 你内心深处有没有……

sentences.en: Just tell me what happens, though, once all of this happens.
sentences.zh: 不过，请告诉我这一切发生之后会怎样。

sentences.en: Let's say you fund a group, and that group supports Hamas, who wants you to die.
sentences.zh: 假设你资助了一个组织，而该组织支持哈马斯，而哈马斯想要你死。

sentences.en: Perhaps you should not fund them.
sentences.zh: 也许你不该资助他们。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But you do...
sentences.zh: 但你确实……

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You do appreciate that when you wade into these very delicate waters, at these very delicate times...
sentences.zh: 你确实明白，当你涉足这些非常敏感的领域，在这些非常敏感的时期……

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: ……这可能会造成真正的……

sentences.zh: 我是说，正如过去两周它所引发的头条新闻一样，造成了经济影响。

sentences.en: I'm just so curious, what happened in your brain, when you see all this happening, are you sitting there going,

sentences.zh: 天哪，我踩坑了。

sentences.en: I wish I didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我没那么做。

sentences.en: Are you saying, screw them, I hate these people, why are they after me?
sentences.zh: 还是你在说，去他们的，我讨厌这些人，他们为什么要针对我？

sentences.en: No, but all of that.
sentences.zh: 不，但所有这些都有。

sentences.zh: 我是说，听着，我为那条推文或帖子感到抱歉。

sentences.zh: 那是我太蠢了。

sentences.en: Of the 30,000, it might be literally the worst and dumbest post that I've ever done.
sentences.zh: 在那三万条帖子中，那可能真的是我写过的最糟糕、最愚蠢的一条。

sentences.en: And I try to do my best to clarify it six ways to Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我试着从各个方面尽力去澄清它。

sentences.en: But, you know, at least I think over time it will be obvious that, in fact, far from being anti-Semitic, I'm, in fact, philo-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，至少我认为随着时间的推移，事实会变得显而易见，我不仅不反犹，实际上我还是亲犹的。

sentences.en: And all the evidence in my track record would support that.
sentences.zh: 我过往的所有记录都能证明这一点。

sentences.en: There are people who say crazy things on X, as you know.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，有些人会在 X 上说些疯狂的话。

sentences.en: Maybe you think they're crazy, maybe they're not.
sentences.zh: 也许你觉得他们疯了，也许他们没疯。

sentences.en: The aspiration for X is to be the global town square.
sentences.zh: X 的愿景是成为全球城市广场。

sentences.en: Now, if you were to walk down to, let's say, Times Square, do you occasionally hear people saying crazy things?
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你走到，比如说时代广场，你会偶尔听到有人说些疯狂的话吗？

sentences.en: Yes, but they don't have the megaphone, right?
sentences.zh: 会，但他们没有扩音器，对吧？

sentences.en: And that's the conundrum.
sentences.zh: 这就是难题所在。

sentences.en: They can only say it to the 50 or 100 people that are standing there in Times Square.
sentences.zh: 他们只能对站在时代广场的那五六十人或一百人说。

sentences.en: Look, the joke I used to make about old Twitter was it was like giving everyone in the psych ward a megaphone.
sentences.zh: 听着，我以前常开玩笑说，旧推特就像给精神病院里的每个人都发了一个扩音器。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'm aware that things can get promoted that are negative beyond the sort of circle of somebody simply screaming crazy things in Times Square,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我意识到有些负面内容可能会被推广，而不仅仅是局限在某个人在时代广场大喊大叫的圈子里，

sentences.en: which happens all the time.
sentences.zh: 那种事随时都在发生。

sentences.en: It's pretty rare for something, frankly, that is hateful to be promoted.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，仇恨言论被推广的情况非常罕见。

sentences.en: It's not that it never happens, but it's fairly rare.
sentences.zh: 并不是说从不发生，但相当罕见。

sentences.en: I mean, I would encourage people to look at, for those that use the system, when you look at the feed that you receive, how often is it hateful?
sentences.zh: 我是说，我会鼓励人们去看看，对于那些使用这个系统的人来说，当你查看你收到的信息流时，它有多频繁是充满仇恨的？

sentences.en: And over time, has it gotten more or less hateful?
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，它是变得更令人憎恶了，还是没那么令人憎恶了？

sentences.en: And I would say that if you look at the X platform today versus a year ago, I think it is actually much better.
sentences.zh: 我会说，如果你看看今天的 X 平台和一年前相比，我认为它实际上好多了。

sentences.en: I mean, what is your personal experience?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你的个人体验如何？

sentences.en: Are you surprised?
sentences.zh: 你感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: I'm just curious.
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇。

sentences.en: I use the platform religiously.
sentences.zh: 我非常频繁地使用这个平台。

sentences.en: I admit to being an addict.
sentences.zh: 我承认我上瘾了。

sentences.en: And I use the for you.
sentences.zh: 我用的是“为你推荐”功能。

sentences.en: And I will say, now, the problem is, because I'm a journalist, I go looking for stuff.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，现在的问题是，因为我是记者，我会主动去寻找内容。

sentences.en: Well, that's not awful.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那并不糟糕。

sentences.en: I'm just saying.
sentences.zh: 我只是随口一说。

sentences.en: And I also think the algorithm, for me personally, because I'm looking for stuff, also is feeding me other things.
sentences.zh: 而且我也认为算法，对我个人而言，因为我在寻找内容，所以也会给我推送其他东西。

sentences.en: This is actually a challenge in that sometimes people will say, like, why is it showing me posts from this person that I hate?
sentences.zh: 这实际上是一个挑战，因为有时人们会问，为什么它给我推送我讨厌的人的帖子？

sentences.en: And we're like, well, did you interact a lot with this person that you hate?
sentences.zh: 我们就会说，好吧，你是不是和这个你讨厌的人互动很多？

sentences.en: Well, yes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: Well, therefore, it thinks that you want to interact more with this person that you hate.
sentences.zh: 好吧，因此，它认为你想要和这个你讨厌的人进行更多互动。

sentences.en: That's like a reasonable.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很合理。

sentences.en: You kind of want to have an argument.
sentences.zh: 你好像想吵架。

sentences.zh: 当你发推文时。

sentences.zh: 你发过帖子吗？

sentences.en: Listen, I'm open.
sentences.zh: 听着，我持开放态度。

sentences.en: If anyone can come up with a better word, that would be great.
sentences.zh: 如果有人能想出更好的词，那就太好了。

sentences.en: When you post, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，当你发帖时。

sentences.en: But the least bad word I can think of is poSt.
sentences.zh: 但我能想到的最不坏的词就是发帖。

sentences.en: When you post, though, are you trying to rile up either a base or an audience?
sentences.zh: 不过，当你发帖时，你是想煽动你的基本盘还是受众？

sentences.en: Do you recognize the power you have in that?
sentences.zh: 你意识到你在这方面拥有的权力了吗？

sentences.en: And also, by the way, not just rile up, but also rile down, which is to say, as I said, there are people who are demonstrably anti-Semitic on the site.
sentences.zh: 而且，顺便说一下，不仅仅是煽动，还有平息，也就是说，正如我所说，网站上确实存在明显的反犹太主义者。

sentences.en: I get Jew boy things and all sorts of things that come my way.
sentences.zh: 我也会收到针对犹太人的攻击和各种各样的言论。

sentences.en: For a while, they thought I was Jewish, so they would, you know, I'd get it, too.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他们以为我是犹太人，所以他们会，你知道，我也会收到这些。

sentences.en: But no, but the question is.
sentences.zh: 但不是，问题是。

sentences.en: My name is super Jewish.
sentences.zh: 我的名字听起来非常像犹太人。

sentences.en: Do you ever think to yourself, you know what?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to go online and I'm going to say these people, I condemn these people that are on my site saying these things.
sentences.zh: 我要上网说，我谴责这些在我网站上发表这些言论的人。

sentences.en: I have.
sentences.zh: 我做过。

sentences.en: You say I've condemned anti-Semitism, but do you ever go.
sentences.zh: 你说你谴责过反犹太主义，但你有没有去……

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I said I literally posted I condemn anti-Semitism in all its forMs.
sentences.zh: 我确实发帖说我谴责一切形式的反犹太主义。

sentences.en: Like that is a literal, I believe, literal post that I made.
sentences.zh: 那是我发过的一条实实在在的帖子，我相信是这样。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm like, listen, if I can get out the thesaurus, if you, you know, and we could, you know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听着，如果我能拿出同义词词典，如果你，你知道，我们本可以……

sentences.en: Let me ask you a different question.
sentences.zh: 让我问你一个不同的问题。

sentences.en: You compose it, I'll post it.
sentences.zh: 你写出来，我来发。

sentences.en: Okay, let me ask you this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我问你这个。

sentences.en: You were on a podcast about a month ago, and you said something that struck me, and it struck me as accurate, came out of your mouth.
sentences.zh: 你大约一个月前参加了一个播客，你说了一些让我印象深刻的话，我觉得很准确，那是从你嘴里说出来的。

sentences.en: So hopefully it is, but I'm hoping we go deep on this.
sentences.zh: 所以希望它是真的，但我希望我们能深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: Just because it came out of my mouth does not mean it's true.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为它从我嘴里说出来，并不意味着它是真的。

sentences.en: No, but you said my mind is a storm.
sentences.zh: 不，但你说过“我的大脑是一场风暴”。

sentences.en: I don't think most people would want to be me.
sentences.zh: 我不认为大多数人会想成为我。

sentences.en: They may think they want to be me, but they don't know.
sentences.zh: 他们可能以为他们想成为我，但他们不知道。

sentences.en: They don't understand.
sentences.zh: 他们不明白。

sentences.en: What did you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Your mind being a storm, I think it, I mean, I have known you for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 你的大脑是一场风暴，我想，我是说，我认识你很久了。

sentences.en: I think it is a bit of a storm.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它确实有点像一场风暴。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, in as much as a weather metaphor makes sense, my mind often feels like a very wild storm.
sentences.zh: 是啊，如果天气隐喻说得通的话，我的大脑经常感觉像是一场非常狂暴的风暴。

sentences.en: I mean, I have a fountain of ideas.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我脑子里有源源不断的想法。

sentences.en: I mean, I have more ideas than I can possibly execute.
sentences.zh: 我的想法多到根本执行不过来。

sentences.en: So I have no shortage of ideas.
sentences.zh: 所以我从不缺想法。

sentences.en: Innovation is not the problem.
sentences.zh: 创新不是问题。

sentences.en: Execution is the problem.
sentences.zh: 执行才是问题。

sentences.en: I've got a million ideas.
sentences.zh: 我有一百万个想法。

sentences.en: I mean, I've got an entire design for an electric supersonic vertical takeoff.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我有一个完整的电动超音速垂直起降飞机的设计。

sentences.en: Jet, but I, I mean, I just, if I, I just can't do that as well.
sentences.zh: 喷气式飞机，但我，我是说，我只是，我就是做不到那么好。

sentences.en: I've had that for 10 years.
sentences.zh: 那个想法我已经有10年了。

sentences.en: And there's a million things.
sentences.zh: 还有一百万件事要做。

sentences.en: Is your storm a happy storm?
sentences.zh: 你的风暴是快乐的风暴吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: It's not a happy storm.
sentences.zh: 那不是快乐的风暴。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: Tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我们说说那是怎么回事。

sentences.en: Because I, I think that that actually, when people try to really understand you, I think that there's, a lot of this comes from some other place.
sentences.zh: 因为我，我觉得实际上，当人们试图真正了解你时，我认为这其中有很多东西源于其他地方。

sentences.en: And I want, I want to talk about that.
sentences.zh: 我想，我想谈谈这个。

sentences.en: What do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你觉得那是什么？

sentences.en: We should really need like a psychiatrist's couch here or something.
sentences.zh: 我们真的需要一张心理医生的躺椅之类的东西。

sentences.en: Um, you know, I, I, I think to some degree I was born this way, but, and then it was amplified by a difficult childhood, frankly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我，我，我觉得在某种程度上我是天生如此，但坦白说，后来又被艰难的童年放大了。

sentences.en: Um, so, uh, but I can remember even in happy moments when I was a kid that there's just, it just feels like there's just a, a rage of forces in my mind constantly.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，呃，但我记得即使在我小时候快乐的时刻，也总觉得，感觉我的脑海里一直有一种狂暴的力量。

sentences.en: Um, but now this, you know, productively manifests itself in technology and building things, uh, for the most part.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但现在，你知道，这在很大程度上富有成效地转化为技术和建造事物。

sentences.en: So, and I, and I think on balance, the output has been very productive.
sentences.zh: 所以，而且我，我认为总的来说，产出是非常有成效的。

sentences.en: Um, I think the results, as we, you know, discussed earlier with SpaceX, Tesla, PayPal, which is, you know, still growing today.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为结果正如我们之前讨论的 SpaceX、特斯拉、PayPal 那样，你知道，它们今天仍在增长。

sentences.en: Um, the, uh, first internet company that I started, in fact, the first internet company I started as a two was, um, uh, funded by New York Times company, Hearst and Knight Ritter.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我创办的第一家互联网公司，事实上，我创办的第一家互联网公司，嗯，是由《纽约时报》公司、赫斯特和奈特·里德共同资助的。

sentences.en: And, uh, we wrote some of the software for the New York Times website.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们为《纽约时报》网站编写了一些软件。

sentences.en: Um, and we helped bring online several hundred, uh, newspapers that previously were only in print.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们帮助数百家以前只有印刷版的报纸实现了在线化。

sentences.en: Um, now this is in the nineties, which at this point is like, I'm like a grandpa player, but basically, um, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在这是在九十年代，在这一点上，我就像个老古董玩家，但基本上，嗯，你知道，

sentences.en: the nineties and internet feels like a pre-Cambrian era when there were only sponges.
sentences.zh: 九十年代和互联网感觉就像只有海绵的寒武纪时代。

sentences.en: Um, so, um, anyway, so, you know, I feel like a lot of productive things have been done and you can also look at Tesla as being sort of many companies in one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，嗯，总之，你知道，我觉得已经完成了很多有成效的事情，你也可以把特斯拉看作是多家公司合为一体。

sentences.en: Um, like our supercharging network is, if it were, if, if, if, if the Tesla supercharging network were its own company, it would be a fortune 500 company by itself.
sentences.zh: 嗯，比如我们的超级充电网络，如果，如果，如果，如果特斯拉超级充电网络是一家独立的公司，它本身就会是一家财富 500 强公司。

sentences.en: Just, just, just the supercharging system.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是，仅仅是，仅仅是超级充电系统。

sentences.en: Um, we also make the cells.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们也制造电池。

sentences.en: We, we, we, we build the power electronics and the powertrain from scratch.
sentences.zh: 我们，我们，我们，我们从零开始构建电力电子设备和动力总成。

sentences.en: Um, we have the most innovative, uh, structural design, the largest castings ever used.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们拥有最具创新性的结构设计，是有史以来最大的铸件。

sentences.en: Um, we have the, the best manufacturing technology at Tesla, better manufacturing technology than companies that have been doing it for a hundred years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在特斯拉拥有最好的制造技术，比那些已经做了百年的公司还要好的制造技术。

sentences.en: So, so these, these demons of the mind, you know, are for the most part, uh, harnessed to productive ends.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些，这些心魔，你知道，在很大程度上，呃，被驾驭到了富有成效的目的上。

sentences.en: Um, but that doesn't mean that once in a while they, you know, go wrong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但这并不意味着它们偶尔，你知道，不会出岔子。

sentences.en: Um, but, but, and this is a question I think a lot of people, you know, are always trying to figure out about not just you, but sometimes themselves.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但是，但是，这是一个我认为很多人，你知道，一直在试图弄清楚的问题，不仅是关于你，有时也是关于他们自己。

sentences.en: Meaning what is driving all of this?
sentences.zh: 意思是这一切的驱动力是什么？

sentences.en: You're doing all of these things.
sentences.zh: 你正在做所有这些事情。

sentences.en: Do you think it's, do you think that you would be as successful, whatever success is, if it wasn't being driven by some,
sentences.zh: 你认为，你认为如果不是由某种东西驱动，你还会像现在这样成功吗——无论成功是什么定义，

sentences.en: I think that there's something you're trying to prove either to yourself or to somebody.
sentences.zh: 我认为你是在试图向自己或某人证明什么。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: We're all trying to prove sound.
sentences.zh: 我们都在试图证明什么。

sentences.en: Maybe I'm trying to prove it to my mother.
sentences.zh: 也许我是在试图向我母亲证明。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: If I were to describe my, my philosophy, it is a philosophy of curiosity.
sentences.zh: 如果要我描述我的哲学，那是一种好奇心的哲学。

sentences.en: Um, it, um, I mean, I, I did have this existential crisis when I was, uh, around 12, uh, about what's the meaning of life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它，嗯，我的意思是，我在 12 岁左右确实经历过这种存在主义危机，关于生命的意义是什么。

sentences.en: Isn't it all pointless?
sentences.zh: 这一切难道不是毫无意义吗？

sentences.zh: 为什么不直接自杀呢？

sentences.en: Why exist?
sentences.zh: 为什么还要存在？

sentences.en: Um, I read the philosophy books, um, that, well, especially the German philosophy books made me quite depressed, frankly,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我读了哲学书，嗯，好吧，特别是德国哲学书让我相当沮丧，坦白说，

sentences.en: once you'd not read Schopenhauer and Nietzsche as a teenager.
sentences.zh: 一旦你在青少年时期读了叔本华和尼采。

sentences.en: Um, but then I read, uh, Douglas Adams, Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, which is a book on philosophy in the form of humor.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但后来我读了道格拉斯·亚当斯的《银河系漫游指南》，那是一本以幽默形式呈现的哲学书。

sentences.en: Um, and the point that, uh, Adams was making there was that, uh, we don't actually know what questions to ask.
sentences.zh: 嗯，亚当斯在那里面表达的观点是，我们实际上不知道该问什么问题。

sentences.en: Um, that's why I said that, you know, the answer is 42, like basically Earth's a giant computer and, and it came up with the answer 42.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是为什么我说，你知道，答案是 42，就像基本上地球是一个巨大的计算机，然后它得出了答案 42。

sentences.en: But then to actually figure out what the question is, that's the actual hard part.
