sentences.zh: 我们认为它已经出来了。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, the genie's certainly poking his head out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，精灵确实已经探出头来了。

sentences.en: The AGI, the idea of artificial general intelligence.
sentences.zh: AGI，即通用人工智能的概念。

sentences.en: Given what you now are working on yourself and you know how easy or hard it is to train, to create the inferences, to create the weights.
sentences.zh: 鉴于你现在自己正在从事的工作，你知道训练、创建推理、创建权重有多容易或多难。

sentences.en: I hope I'm not getting too far in the weeds of just how this works, but those are the basics behind the software end of this.
sentences.zh: 我希望我没有陷入这些软件底层运作的琐碎细节中，但这些就是软件层面的基本原理。

sentences.en: It's funny, you know, all these weights, they're just basically numbers in a comma-separated value file.
sentences.zh: 很有趣，你知道，所有这些权重，基本上只是逗号分隔值文件里的数字。

sentences.en: And that's our digital god, a CSV file.
sentences.zh: 而这就是我们的数字上帝，一个 CSV 文件。

sentences.en: Not that funny.
sentences.zh: 没那么好笑。

sentences.en: But that's kind of literally what it is.
sentences.zh: 但这确实就是它的字面意思。

sentences.en: So I think it's coming pretty fast, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为它来得相当快，你知道。

sentences.en: Is that, I mean, you famously have admitted to overstating how quickly things will happen.
sentences.zh: 那是，我的意思是，你曾公开承认过高估了事情发生的进度。

sentences.en: But how quickly do you think this will happen?
sentences.zh: 但你认为这会发生得有多快？

sentences.en: If you say smarter than the smartest human at anything.
sentences.zh: 如果你说的是在任何方面都比最聪明的人类更聪明。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It may not be then quite smarter than all humans, all machine-augmented humans, you know, because people have got computers and stuff.
sentences.zh: 那可能还不完全比所有人类、所有机器增强的人类更聪明，你知道，因为人们有电脑之类的东西。

sentences.en: It's a higher bar.
sentences.zh: 这是一个更高的门槛。

sentences.en: But if you say smarter than any, you know, can write as good a novel as, say, J.K.
sentences.zh: 但如果你说的是比任何人都聪明，你知道，能写出像 J.K. 罗琳那样好的小说，

sentences.en: Rowling or discover new physics or invent new technology.
sentences.zh: 或者发现新的物理学，或者发明新的技术。

sentences.en: I would say that we are less than three years from that point.
sentences.zh: 我会说我们距离那个时间点不到三年。

sentences.en: Let me ask you a question about XAI and what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 让我问你一个关于 XAI 以及你正在做的事情的问题。

sentences.en: And because there's an interesting thing that's different, I think, about what you have relative to some of the others.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为你所拥有的东西与其他人相比有一个有趣的不同点。

sentences.en: Which is you have data.
sentences.zh: 那就是你有数据。

sentences.en: You have information.
sentences.zh: 你有信息。

sentences.en: You have all of the stuff that everybody in here has put on the platform to sort through.
sentences.zh: 你有这里每个人放在平台上供筛选的所有内容。

sentences.en: And I don't know if everybody realized that initially.
sentences.zh: 我不知道大家最初是否意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: What is the value of that?
sentences.zh: 那有什么价值？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, data is very important.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，数据非常重要。

sentences.en: You could say data is probably more valuable than gold.
sentences.zh: 你可以说数据可能比黄金更有价值。

sentences.en: But then maybe you have actually, maybe you have more, maybe you have the gold in X in a different way.
sentences.zh: 但也许你实际上有更多，也许你在 X 以不同的方式拥有黄金。

sentences.en: In a way, again, that I don't know if the public appreciates what that means.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，我不知道公众是否理解这意味着什么。

sentences.en: Yes, X is the, might be the single best source of data.
sentences.zh: 是的，X 可能是最好的单一数据来源。

sentences.en: I mean, it is, there are more, you know, people, links that go to, people click on more links to X than anything else on Earth.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，确实是这样，你知道，人们点击 X 的链接比地球上任何其他地方都多。

sentences.en: Sometimes people think Facebook or Instagram is a bigger thing.
sentences.zh: 有时人们认为 Facebook 或 Instagram 更大。

sentences.en: But actually, there are more links to X than anything.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，指向 X 的链接比任何东西都多。

sentences.en: You can, there's public information.
sentences.zh: 你可以，有公开信息。

sentences.en: You can Google it.
sentences.zh: 你可以去谷歌搜索一下。

sentences.en: Okay, let me ask you a, so it is, it is where you would find what is happening right now on Earth at any given point in time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我问你一个，所以它确实是，它确实是你可以在任何给定时间点找到地球上正在发生什么的地方。

sentences.en: The whole open eye drama played out, in fact, on the X platform.
sentences.zh: 整个 OpenAI 的闹剧，事实上，就是在 X 平台上演的。

sentences.en: So, it is one of the, it's not, you know, Google certainly has a massive amount of data, so does Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 所以，它是其中之一，它不是，你知道，谷歌当然拥有海量数据，微软也是。

sentences.en: So, it's not like, but it is one of the best sources of data.
sentences.zh: 所以，并不是说，但它确实是最好的数据来源之一。

sentences.en: Can I ask you an interesting IP issue, which I think is actually something I can say as somebody who's in the creator business and journalistic business and whatnot,
sentences.zh: 我可以问你一个有趣的知识产权问题吗？我认为作为一个从事创作和新闻业务的人，我可以提出这个问题，

sentences.en: where I care about copyright.
sentences.zh: 我关心版权。

sentences.en: So, one of the things about training on data has been this idea that you're not going to train, or these things are not being trained on people's copyrighted information.
sentences.zh: 所以，关于数据训练的一件事是，人们认为你不会去训练，或者这些东西不是在人们受版权保护的信息上进行训练的。

sentences.en: Historically, that's been the concept.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，这一直是这个概念。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a huge lie.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是个弥天大谎。

sentences.en: Say that again?
sentences.zh: 再说一遍？

sentences.en: Yes, these AI, or these AI's are all trained on copyrighted data, obviously.
sentences.zh: 是的，这些 AI，或者这些 AI 显然都是在受版权保护的数据上训练的。

sentences.en: So, you think it's a lie when OpenAI says that this is not, none of these guys say they're training on copyrighted data.
sentences.zh: 所以，你认为 OpenAI 说这不是，这些家伙中没有一个人说他们在受版权保护的数据上进行训练，这是一种谎言。

sentences.en: That's a lie.
sentences.zh: 那是谎言。

sentences.en: It's a lie, straight up.
sentences.zh: 这是谎言，直截了当的谎言。

sentences.en: It's a straight up lie.
sentences.zh: 这是一个彻头彻尾的谎言。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。
百分之百。

sentences.en: Obviously, it's been trained on copyrighted data.
sentences.zh: 显然，它是在受版权保护的数据上训练的。

sentences.en: Okay, so let me ask the second question, which is, all of the people who have been uploading articles, the best quotes from different articles, videos, 2X,
sentences.zh: 好的，让我问第二个问题，那就是，所有上传文章、不同文章中的最佳引语、视频到 X 的人，

sentences.en: all of that can be trained on.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都可以用来训练。

sentences.en: And it's interesting, because people put all of that there, and those quotes have historically been considered fair use, right?
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为人们把所有这些都放在那里，而这些引语在历史上一直被认为是合理使用，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: People are putting those quotes up there.
sentences.zh: 人们把那些引语放上去。

sentences.en: And individually, on a fair use basis, you'd say, okay, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 单独来看，在合理使用的基础上，你会说，好吧，这说得通。

sentences.en: But now there are people who do threads, and by the way, there may be multiple people who've done, you know, an article that has 1,000 words.
sentences.zh: 但现在有人做推文串，顺便说一句，可能有多个人做过，你知道，一篇文章有 1000 个字。

sentences.en: Technically, all 1,000 words could have made it onto X somehow.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，所有 1000 个字可能以某种方式出现在了 X 上。

sentences.en: And effectively, now you have this remarkable repository.
sentences.zh: 实际上，你现在拥有了一个非凡的存储库。

sentences.en: And I wonder what you, how you think about that, again, and how you think the creative community and those who were the original IP owners should think about that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是怎么想的，再次，以及你认为创意社区和那些原始知识产权所有者应该如何看待这一点。

sentences.en: I don't know, except to say that by the time these lawsuits are decided, we'll have Digital God.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，只能说等到这些诉讼有结果时，我们已经有了数字上帝。

sentences.en: So I asked Digital God at that point.
sentences.zh: 所以我到时候去问数字上帝。

sentences.en: I mean, these lawsuits won't be decided before in a time frame that is relevant.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些诉讼不会在相关的时间框架内得到解决。

sentences.en: Is that a good thing or a bad thing?
sentences.zh: 这是一件好事还是坏事？

sentences.en: I think we live, you know, there's that, I don't know if it's actually a real Chinese saying or not, but maybe live in interesting times.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们生活在，你知道，有那句话，我不知道这是否真的是一句中国谚语，但也许是生活在有趣的时代。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's apparently not a good thing.
sentences.zh: 显然这不是一件好事。

sentences.en: But I would prefer to, personally, I would prefer to live in interesting times.
sentences.zh: 但我个人更愿意，我更愿意生活在有趣的时代。

sentences.en: And we live in the most interesting of times.
sentences.zh: 而我们正生活在最有趣的时代。

sentences.en: I think, for a while ago, I was, like, really getting demotivated and losing sleep over the sort of the threat of AI danger.
sentences.zh: 我想，前一阵子，我真的感到非常消极，因为 AI 危险的威胁而失眠。

sentences.en: And then I finally sort of became fatalistic about it and said, well, even if I knew it was, annihilation was certain, would I choose to be alive at that time or not?
sentences.zh: 然后我终于对它产生了一种宿命论，说，好吧，即使我知道它，毁灭是肯定的，我是否会选择生活在那个时代？

sentences.en: And I said, I probably would have choose to be alive at that time because it's the most interesting thing, even if there's nothing I could do about it.
sentences.zh: 我说，我可能会选择生活在那个时代，因为这是最有趣的事情，即使我对此无能为力。

sentences.en: So then, you know, then basically sort of a fatalistic resignation helped me sleep at night because I was having trouble sleeping at night because of AI danger.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，基本上那种宿命论的顺从帮助我晚上睡着了，因为我之前因为 AI 危险而难以入眠。

sentences.en: Now, what to do about it?
sentences.zh: 那么，该怎么办呢？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I've been the biggest, the one banging the drum, the hardest, by far the longest, or at least one of the longest for AI danger.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，我一直是那个敲响警钟的人，声音最大，时间最长，或者至少是 AI 危险论最久的倡导者之一。

sentences.en: And these regulatory things that are happening, the single biggest reason they're happening is because of me.
sentences.zh: 而这些正在发生的监管措施，它们发生的最大原因就是因为我。

sentences.en: Do you think they're ever going to get their arms around it?
sentences.zh: 你认为他们能控制住它吗？

sentences.en: We talked to the vice president this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我们今天下午和副总统谈过了。

sentences.en: She said she wants to regulate it.
sentences.zh: 她说她想监管它。

sentences.en: People have been trying to regulate social media for years and have done nothing effectively.
sentences.zh: 人们多年来一直试图监管社交媒体，但什么也没做成。

sentences.en: Well, there's regulation around anything which is like a physical danger or a danger to the public.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于任何像物理危险或对公众有危险的事情，都有监管。

sentences.en: So, like, cars are heavily regulated.
sentences.zh: 所以，比如，汽车受到严格监管。

sentences.en: Communications are heavily regulated.
sentences.zh: 通信受到严格监管。

sentences.en: Rockets and aircraft are heavily regulated.
sentences.zh: 火箭和飞机受到严格监管。

sentences.en: The general philosophy about regulation is that when something is a danger to the public, that there needs to be some government oversight.
sentences.zh: 关于监管的一般哲学是，当某件事对公众构成危险时，就需要政府的监督。

sentences.en: So I think, in my view, AI is more dangerous than nuclear bombs.
sentences.zh: 所以在我看来，AI 比核弹更危险。

sentences.en: And we regulate nuclear bombs.
sentences.zh: 而我们监管核弹。

sentences.en: You can't just go make a nuclear bomb in your backyard.
sentences.zh: 你不能随便在后院制造核弹。

sentences.en: I think we should have some kind of regulation with AI.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该对 AI 进行某种监管。

sentences.en: Now, this tends to cause the AI accelerations to get up in arms because they think AI is sort of heaven, basically.
sentences.zh: 现在，这往往会导致 AI 加速主义者感到愤怒，因为他们基本上认为 AI 是某种天堂。

sentences.en: But you typically don't like regulation.
sentences.zh: 但你通常不喜欢监管。

sentences.en: You've pushed back on regulators for the most part in the world of Tesla.
sentences.zh: 在特斯拉的世界里，你大部分时间都在抵制监管机构。

sentences.en: So many instances where we read articles about you pushing back on the regulators.
sentences.zh: 我们读到过很多关于你抵制监管机构的文章。

sentences.en: I'm so curious why, in this instance, now you own one of these businesses.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇为什么在这种情况下，现在你拥有了这些企业之一。

sentences.en: As I said a moment ago, one should not take what is viewed in the media as being the whole picture.
sentences.zh: 正如我刚才所说，人们不应该把媒体上看到的内容当作全貌。

sentences.en: There are literally hundreds.
sentences.zh: 确实有成百上千条。

sentences.en: This is not an exaggeration.
sentences.zh: 这不是夸张。

sentences.en: So there are probably 100 million regulations that my companies comply with.
sentences.zh: 所以我的公司可能遵守了 1 亿条法规。

sentences.en: And there are probably five that we don't.
sentences.zh: 可能只有五条我们没有遵守。

sentences.en: And if we disagree with some of those regulations, it's because we think the regulation that is meant to do good doesn't actually do good.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不同意其中的一些法规，那是因为我们认为旨在做好事的法规实际上并没有做好事。

sentences.en: But that's an interesting thing.
sentences.zh: 但那是一件有趣的事情。

sentences.en: It is not defying regulations for the sake of...
sentences.zh: 这不是为了反抗而反抗法规……

sentences.en: If there are laws and rules, whether the idea is that you're making the decision that the law and the rule shouldn't be the law and the rule, and then...
sentences.zh: 如果有法律和规则，你的想法是你在做出决定，认为法律和规则不应该是法律和规则，然后……

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Isn't...
sentences.zh: 不是……

sentences.en: No, I'm saying you're fundamentally mistaken.
sentences.zh: 不，我是说你从根本上错了。

sentences.en: And it should be obvious that you're mistaken.
sentences.zh: 而且你应该显而易见地知道你错了。

sentences.en: My company's automotive is heavily regulated.
sentences.zh: 我的汽车公司受到严格监管。

sentences.en: We would not be allowed to put cars on the road if we did not comply with this vast body of regulation.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不遵守这些庞大的法规体系，我们就不被允许让汽车上路。

sentences.en: Now, you could fill up a stage with literally, you know, six foot high...
sentences.zh: 现在，你可以用字面意义上的，你知道，六英尺高的……填满一个舞台。

sentences.en: The regulations that you have to comply with to make a car, you could have a room full of phone books.
sentences.zh: 制造汽车必须遵守的法规，你可以装满一屋子的电话簿。

sentences.en: That's how big the regulations are.
sentences.zh: 法规就是这么庞大。

sentences.en: And if you don't comply with all of those, you can't sell the car.
sentences.zh: 如果你不遵守所有这些，你就不能卖车。

sentences.en: And if we don't comply with all the regulations for rockets or for Starlink, they shut us down.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不遵守火箭或星链的所有法规，他们就会关闭我们。

sentences.en: So, in fact, I am incredibly compliant with regulations.
sentences.zh: 所以，事实上，我非常遵守法规。

sentences.en: Now, once in a while, there'll be something that I disagree with.
sentences.zh: 现在，偶尔会有我不同意的事情。

sentences.en: The reason I would disagree with this is because I think the regulation in that particular case, in that rare case, does not serve the public good.
sentences.zh: 我不同意的原因是因为我认为在那个特定情况下，在那个罕见的情况下，该法规不符合公共利益。

sentences.en: And therefore, I think it is my obligation to object to a regulation that is meant to serve the public good if it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为如果一项旨在服务公共利益的法规实际上并没有做到，我有义务反对它。

sentences.en: That's the only time I object.
sentences.zh: 只有在那时我才会反对。

sentences.en: Not because I seek to object.
sentences.zh: 不是因为我寻求反对。

sentences.en: In fact, I'm incredibly rule-following.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我非常遵守规则。

sentences.en: Let me ask you a separate question.
sentences.zh: 让我问你一个单独的问题。

sentences.en: It's a social media-related question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个与社交媒体相关的问题。

sentences.en: We've been talking about TikTok today, ahead of the election.
sentences.zh: 我们今天在选举前一直在谈论 TikTok。

sentences.en: TikTok is...
sentences.zh: TikTok 是……

sentences.en: What do you think of TikTok?
sentences.zh: 你觉得 TikTok 怎么样？

sentences.en: Do you think it's a national security threat?
sentences.zh: 你认为这构成了国家安全威胁吗？

sentences.en: I don't use TikTok.
sentences.zh: 我不使用 TikTok。

sentences.en: Say that again?
sentences.zh: 再说一遍？

sentences.en: You don't?
sentences.zh: 你不使用？

sentences.en: I don't personally use it.
sentences.zh: 我个人不使用它。

sentences.en: But for teenagers and people in their 20s, they seem almost religiously addicted to TikTok.
sentences.zh: 但对于青少年和二十多岁的人来说，他们似乎对 TikTok 有种近乎宗教般的沉迷。

sentences.en: Some people will watch TikTok for like two hours a day.
sentences.zh: 有些人每天会花大约两个小时刷 TikTok。

sentences.en: I stopped using TikTok when I felt the AI probing my mind, and it made me uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 我停止使用 TikTok 是因为我感觉到人工智能在窥探我的思想，这让我感到不舒服。

sentences.en: So I stopped using it.
sentences.zh: 所以我不再用了。

sentences.en: And in terms of anti-Semitic content, I mean, TikTok is rife with that.
sentences.zh: 至于反犹太主义内容，我的意思是，TikTok 上到处都是这种内容。

sentences.en: It has the most viral anti-Semitic content by far.
sentences.zh: 它是目前为止病毒式传播的反犹太内容最多的平台。

sentences.en: But do you think the Chinese government is using it to manipulate the minds of Americans?
sentences.zh: 但你认为中国政府正在利用它来操纵美国人的思想吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Is that something that you think we should worry about?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是我们应该担心的事情吗？

sentences.en: I mean, you have different states that are trying to ban it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在有不同的州正试图封禁它。

sentences.en: I don't think this is some Chinese government plot.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这是什么中国政府的阴谋。

sentences.en: But it is...
sentences.zh: 但它确实……

sentences.en: The TikTok algorithm is entirely AI powered.
sentences.zh: TikTok 的算法完全是由人工智能驱动的。

sentences.en: So it is really just trying to find the most viral thing possible.
sentences.zh: 所以它实际上只是在试图寻找传播力最强的内容。

sentences.en: It's what is going to keep you glued to the screen.
sentences.zh: 这就是让你目不转睛盯着屏幕的原因。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: Now, on sheer numbers, there are on the order of 2 billion Muslims in the world.
sentences.zh: 现在，单从数量上看，世界上大约有 20 亿穆斯林。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, much smaller number of Jewish people, 20 million something, many orders of magnitude fewer.
sentences.zh: 而我认为，犹太人的数量要少得多，大概 2000 万左右，少了几个数量级。

sentences.en: So if you just look at content production, just on sheer numbers basis, is it going to be overwhelmingly anti-Semitic?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你只看内容产出，单从纯粹的数量基础来看，它会呈现出压倒性的反犹太倾向吗？

sentences.en: Let me ask you a political question.
sentences.zh: 让我问你一个政治问题。

sentences.en: And I've been trying to square this one in my head for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我一直在脑子里试图理清这个问题，已经很久了。

sentences.en: In the last two or three years, you have moved decidedly to the right, I think.
sentences.zh: 在过去两三年里，我认为你明显向右转了。

sentences.en: Have I?
sentences.zh: 我有吗？

sentences.en: Well, we can discuss this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们可以讨论一下。

sentences.en: I think that you have been espousing and promoting a number of Republican candidates and others.
sentences.zh: 我认为你一直在支持和推广一些共和党候选人及其他人。

sentences.en: You've been very frustrated with the Biden administration over, I think, unions and feeling like they did not respect what you've created.
sentences.zh: 你对拜登政府非常失望，我想是因为工会问题，而且你觉得他们没有尊重你的成就。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, without any – doing nothing to provoke the Biden administration, they held an electric vehicle summit at the White House and specifically refused to let Tesla attend.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，在没有任何挑衅拜登政府的情况下，他们在白宫举行了一场电动汽车峰会，并明确拒绝让特斯拉参加。

sentences.en: This was in the first six months of the administration.
sentences.zh: 这发生在该政府执政的前六个月。

sentences.en: And we inquired, we're like, we literally make more electric cars than everyone else combined.
sentences.zh: 我们当时询问过，我们说，我们制造的电动汽车数量实际上比其他所有厂商加起来还要多。

sentences.en: Why are we not allowed?
sentences.zh: 为什么不允许我们参加？

sentences.en: Why are you only letting Ford, GM, Chrysler and UAW and you're specifically disallowing us from the EV summit at the White House?
sentences.zh: 为什么你们只让福特、通用、克莱斯勒和全美汽车工人联合会参加，却专门把我们排除在白宫电动汽车峰会之外？

sentences.en: We've done nothing to provoke them.
sentences.zh: 我们没有做任何挑衅他们的事。

sentences.en: Then, Biden went on to add insult to injury and publicly said that GM was leading the electric car revolution.
sentences.zh: 然后，拜登更是雪上加霜，公开声称通用汽车正在引领电动汽车革命。

sentences.en: This was in the same quarter that Tesla made 300,000 electric cars and GM made 26.
sentences.zh: 这发生在同一个季度，当时特斯拉生产了 30 万辆电动汽车，而通用汽车只生产了 26 辆。

sentences.en: Does that seem fair to you?
sentences.zh: 这在你看来公平吗？

sentences.en: So, but tell me this then.
sentences.zh: 那么，告诉我这个。

sentences.en: It doesn't seem fair.
sentences.zh: 这看起来不公平。

sentences.en: And I've asked repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 而且我反复问过。

sentences.en: You've probably seen me.
sentences.zh: 你可能也看到了。

sentences.en: And by the way, I had a great relationship with Obama.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我和奥巴马的关系很好。

sentences.en: So, there's not a – But then there's this.
sentences.zh: 所以，并不是……但后来发生了这件事。

sentences.en: I voted for Obama.
sentences.zh: 我投了奥巴马的票。

sentences.en: I stood in line for six hours to shake Obama's head.
sentences.zh: 我排了六个小时的队去和奥巴马握手。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: So, let me just ask on a personal level.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我从个人层面问一下。

sentences.en: I can see it in your face.
sentences.zh: 我能从你的脸上看出来。

sentences.en: This hurt you personally.
sentences.zh: 这让你个人受到了伤害。

sentences.en: And it hurt the company too.
sentences.zh: 而且这对公司也造成了伤害。

sentences.en: And it was an insult to – Tesla has 140,000 employees.
sentences.zh: 这对特斯拉的 14 万名员工来说也是一种侮辱。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: Half of them are in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们中有一半在美国。

sentences.en: Tesla has created more manufacturing jobs than everyone else combined.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉创造的制造业就业岗位比其他所有公司加起来还要多。

sentences.en: So, let me ask this then.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我问这个。

sentences.en: You've devoted at least the last close to 20 years of your life, if not more, to the climate, climate change, trying to get Tesla off the ground, in part to improve climate.
sentences.zh: 你至少投入了过去近 20 年的生命，甚至更多，致力于气候和气候变化问题，试图让特斯拉起步，部分原因就是为了改善气候。

sentences.en: You've talked about that.
sentences.zh: 你谈到过这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: A real right-wing motive is –
sentences.zh: 一个真正的右翼动机是——

sentences.en: Repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 反复提到过。

sentences.en: Got it far right, if anything.
sentences.zh: 如果非要说的话，那是极右翼。

sentences.en: No, I understand that.
sentences.zh: 不，我明白这一点。

sentences.en: And then it's –
sentences.zh: 然后是——

sentences.en: It's reverse psychology next level.
sentences.zh: 这是更高层面的反向心理。

sentences.en: Well, no, but so here's then the question, which is how do you square the support that you have given – I believe you were at a fundraiser for Vivek Ramaswamy, for example,
sentences.zh: 好吧，不，所以问题就在这里，你是如何调和对那些人的支持的——我相信你参加了维韦克·拉马斯瓦米的筹款活动，例如，

sentences.en: who says that the climate issue is a hoax.
sentences.zh: 他说气候问题是一个骗局。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: I disagree with him on that.
sentences.zh: 我在这一点上不同意他的看法。

sentences.en: But I would think that that would be such a singular issue for you.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这对你来说应该是一个单一议题。

sentences.en: I would think that the climate issue would be such a singular issue for you that actually it would disqualify almost anybody who didn't take that issue seriously.
sentences.zh: 我认为气候问题对你来说应该是一个单一议题，以至于实际上它会取消几乎任何不认真对待这个问题的人的资格。

sentences.en: Well, I haven't endorsed anyone for president.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没有支持任何总统候选人。

sentences.en: I mean, I wanted to hear what Vivek had to say because I think some of his things are – that's one of the things he says I think are pretty solid.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想听听维韦克要说什么，因为我认为他的一些观点——他说的其中一些事情我认为相当扎实。

sentences.en: But, you know, he's concerned about government overreach, about government control of information.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，他关心政府越权，关心政府对信息的控制。

sentences.en: I mean, the degree to which old Twitter was basically a sock puppet of the government was ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，旧 Twitter 基本上是政府的傀儡，这种程度简直荒谬。

sentences.en: So, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，

sentences.en: it seems to me that there's a very severe violation of the First Amendment in terms of how much the government control – how much control the government had over old Twitter.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，就政府对旧 Twitter 的控制程度而言，这严重违反了第一修正案。

sentences.en: And it no longer does.
sentences.zh: 现在不再是这样了。

sentences.en: So, you know, there's a reason for the First Amendment.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，第一修正案是有原因的。

sentences.en: The reason for the First Amendment for freedom of speech is because the people that immigrated to this country came from places where there was not freedom of speech.
sentences.zh: 第一修正案关于言论自由的原因是，移民到这个国家的人来自没有言论自由的地方。

sentences.en: And they were like, you know what, we've got to make sure that that's constitutional.
sentences.zh: 他们当时想，你知道吗，我们必须确保这一点写进宪法。

sentences.en: Because where they came from, if they said something, they'd be put in prison or they'd be, you know, something bad would happen to them.
sentences.zh: 因为在他们来的地方，如果他们说了什么，他们就会被关进监狱，或者，你知道，会发生糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: So – and freedom of speech, you have to say, when is it relevant?
sentences.zh: 所以——关于言论自由，你必须问，它什么时候才有意义？

sentences.en: It's only relevant when someone you don't like can say something you don't like or it has no meaning.
sentences.zh: 只有当你不喜欢的人能说出你不喜欢的话时，它才有意义，否则它就毫无意义。

sentences.en: And as soon as you sort of, you know, throw in the towel and concede to censorship, it is only a matter of time before someone censors you.
sentences.zh: 一旦你某种程度上，你知道，认输并屈服于审查制度，那么有人审查你也只是时间问题。

sentences.en: And that is why we have the First Amendment.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们拥有第一修正案的原因。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Could you see yourself voting for President Biden?
sentences.zh: 你能想象自己投票给拜登总统吗？

sentences.en: If it's a Biden-Trump election, for example?
sentences.zh: 例如，如果是一场拜登对特朗普的选举？

sentences.en: I think I would not vote for Biden.
sentences.zh: 我想我不会投票给拜登。

sentences.en: You'd vote for Trump.
sentences.zh: 你会投票给特朗普。

sentences.en: I'm not saying I'd vote for Trump, but I mean, this is definitely a difficult choice here, you know.
sentences.zh: 我不是说我会投票给特朗普，但我的意思是，这绝对是一个艰难的选择，你知道。

sentences.en: Would you vote for Nikki Haley?
sentences.zh: 你会投票给尼基·黑利吗？

sentences.en: Nikki Haley, by the way, wants all social media names to be exposed, as you know.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，如你所知，尼基·黑利希望所有社交媒体账号实名化。

sentences.en: No, I think that's outrageous.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为那太离谱了。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, I'm not going to vote for some pro-censorship candidate.
sentences.zh: 是的，不，我不会投票给任何支持审查制度的候选人。

sentences.en: Like I said, I mean, I think these – you have to, you know, consider that there is a lot of wisdom in these amendments, you know, in the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我的意思是，我认为这些——你必须，你知道，考虑到这些修正案，你知道，宪法中蕴含着很多智慧。

sentences.en: And, you know, a lot of these – a lot of things that we take for granted here in the United States that don't even exist in Canada.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，很多这些——很多我们在美国认为理所当然的事情，在加拿大甚至都不存在。

sentences.en: There's not – no constitutional right to freedom of speech in Canada.
sentences.zh: 在加拿大，宪法中没有言论自由的权利。

sentences.en: So, you know, and there's no Miranda rights in Canada.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，而且加拿大没有米兰达警告。

sentences.en: People, like, think, like, you know, you have the right to remain silent.
sentences.zh: 人们，比如，认为，你知道，你有权保持沉默。

sentences.en: You don't, actually, in Canada.
sentences.zh: 实际上，在加拿大你没有。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'm half Canadian.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我是半个加拿大人。

sentences.en: I can say these things off of us.
sentences.zh: 我可以随口说这些。

sentences.en: But, you know, so, like, you just got – the freedom of speech is incredibly important, even when people – and, like I said, it's actually especially important.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，所以，就像，你必须——言论自由极其重要，即使当人们——就像我说的，实际上它尤其重要。

sentences.en: In fact, it is only relevant when people you don't like can say things you don't like.
sentences.zh: 事实上，只有当你不喜欢的人能说出你不喜欢的话时，它才有意义。

sentences.en: And do you think right now –
sentences.zh: 你认为现在——

sentences.en: They're meaningless.
sentences.zh: 它们毫无意义。

sentences.en: You think right now the Republican candidates or the Democrats are more inclined – I mean, this is where you go to, I assume,
sentences.zh: 你认为现在共和党候选人还是民主党候选人更倾向于——我的意思是，这就是你所说的，我假设，

sentences.en: to woke and anti-woke and the mind virus issue that you've talked about.
sentences.zh: 关于觉醒派、反觉醒派以及你谈到的思想病毒问题。

sentences.en: Which party do you think is more pro-freedom of speech, given all the things you've seen?
sentences.zh: 考虑到你所看到的一切，你认为哪个党派更支持言论自由？

sentences.en: Because we also see, you know, DeSantis, you know, preventing people from reading certain things.
sentences.zh: 因为我们也看到，你知道，德桑蒂斯，你知道，阻止人们阅读某些东西。

sentences.en: Maybe you think that's correct.
sentences.zh: 也许你认为那是对的。

sentences.en: Now, look, we actually are in an odd situation here where, on balance, the Democrats appear to be more pro-censorship than the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 现在，听着，我们实际上处于一种奇怪的境地，总的来说，民主党人似乎比共和党人更支持审查制度。

sentences.en: I mean, that used to be the opposite.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，过去情况正好相反。

sentences.en: It used to be, you know, the left position was freedom of speech.
sentences.zh: 过去，你知道，左派的立场是言论自由。

sentences.en: You know, I believe at one point, the ACLU even defended the right of someone to claim that they were a Nazi or something like that, you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我相信在某个时候，美国公民自由联盟甚至捍卫了某人声称自己是纳粹之类的权利，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So, like, there really were – like, the left was – freedom of speech is fundamental.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像，确实曾经有——就像，左派是——言论自由是根本。

sentences.en: And, I mean, my perception, perhaps it is inaccurate, is that the pro-censorship is more on the left than the right.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的看法，也许不准确，是支持审查制度的倾向在左派比在右派更多。

sentences.en: We certainly get more complaints from the left than the right, let me put it that way.
sentences.zh: 我们确实收到了更多来自左派而不是右派的投诉，我这么说吧。

sentences.en: So, but my aspiration for the X platform is that it is the best source of truth, or the least inaccurate source of truth.
sentences.zh: 所以，但我对 X 平台的愿望是，它成为最好的真相来源，或者最不失真的真相来源。

sentences.en: And, well, you know, I don't know if you will believe me or not, but I think honesty is the best policy.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，你知道，我不知道你信不信，但我认为诚实是最好的策略。

sentences.en: And I think that the truth will win over time.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为真相终将获胜。

sentences.en: And, you know, we've got this great system, and it's getting better, called Community Notes, which is fantastic, I think, at correcting falsehoods or adding context.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们有一个很棒的系统，而且它正在变得更好，叫做“社区笔记”，我认为它在纠正错误信息或添加背景信息方面非常出色。

sentences.en: In fact, we make a point of not removing anything but only adding context.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们坚持不删除任何内容，只添加背景信息。

sentences.en: Now, that context could include that this is completely false, and here's why.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些背景信息可能包括指出这是完全错误的，并说明原因。

sentences.en: And no one is immune to this.
sentences.zh: 没有人能免于此。

sentences.en: I'm not immune to it.
sentences.zh: 我不能免于此。

sentences.en: Advertisers are not immune to it.
sentences.zh: 广告商也不能免于此。

sentences.en: In fact, we've had Community Notes, which has caused us some loss in advertising, speaking of loss in advertising revenue.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们有社区笔记，这导致我们损失了一些广告，说到广告收入损失。

sentences.en: If a Community Note – if there's false advertising, the Community Note will say, this is false, and here is why.
sentences.zh: 如果有一条社区笔记——如果存在虚假广告，社区笔记会说，这是虚假的，原因如下。

sentences.en: I mean, like – and there's one specific example that is public knowledge, so I'll mention it, which is, at one point, Uber had this ad which said, earn like a boss.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像——有一个具体的例子是公开的，所以我提一下，就是，有一次，优步有这个广告，说“像老板一样赚钱”。

sentences.en: And it was community noted.
sentences.zh: 结果被社区笔记标注了。

sentences.en: If by a boss you mean $12.47 an hour, this did cause at least a temporary suspension of advertising from Uber.
sentences.zh: 如果老板的意思是每小时 12.47 美元，这确实导致优步至少暂时停止了广告投放。

sentences.en: I got to ask you a question that might make everybody in the room uncomfortable or not uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 我得问你一个可能会让房间里每个人感到不舒服或者不舒服的问题。

sentences.en: It goes to the free speech issue.
sentences.zh: 这涉及言论自由问题。

sentences.en: The New York Times company and the New York Times newspaper, it appeared over the summer to be throttled.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》公司和《纽约时报》报纸，在夏天看起来似乎被限流了。

sentences.en: What did?
sentences.zh: 什么被限流了？

sentences.en: The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Well, we do require that everyone has to buy a subscription, and we don't make exceptions for anyone.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们确实要求每个人都必须购买订阅，我们不对任何人搞特殊化。

sentences.en: And I think if I want the New York Times, I have to pay for a subscription, and they don't give me a free subscription.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为如果我想要《纽约时报》，我必须支付订阅费，他们不会给我免费订阅。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to give them a free subscription.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会给他们免费订阅。

sentences.en: But were you throttling the New York Times relative to other news organizations, relative to everybody else?
sentences.zh: 但你是否在相对于其他新闻机构，相对于其他人，对《纽约时报》进行限流？

sentences.en: Was it specific to the Times?
sentences.zh: 这是针对《时报》的吗？

sentences.en: They didn't buy a subscription.
sentences.zh: 他们没有购买订阅。

sentences.en: And by the way, it only costs like $1,000 a month.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，它一个月只需要 1000 美元左右。

sentences.en: So if they just do that, then they're back in the saddle.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们那样做了，他们就恢复正常了。

sentences.en: But you are saying that it was throttled?
sentences.zh: 但你是说它被限流了吗？

sentences.en: No, I'm saying...
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是……

sentences.en: I mean, was there a conversation that you had with somebody who said,
sentences.zh: 我是说，有没有人和你谈过，他们说，

sentences.en: Look, you know, I'm unhappy with the Times.
sentences.zh: 听着，你知道，我对《纽约时报》很不满。

sentences.en: They should either be buying a subscription or I don't like their content or whatever.
sentences.zh: 他们要么应该买订阅，要么就是我不喜欢他们的内容，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Any organization that refuses to buy a subscription is not going to be recommended.
sentences.zh: 任何拒绝购买订阅的机构都不会被推荐。

sentences.en: But then what does that say about free speech?
sentences.zh: 但那对言论自由意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: And what does that say about amplifying certain voices?
sentences.zh: 那对于放大某些声音又意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: Free speech is not exactly free.
sentences.zh: 言论自由并非完全免费。

sentences.en: It costs a little bit.
sentences.zh: 它需要一点代价。

sentences.en: But that's an interesting...
sentences.zh: 但这是一个有趣的……

sentences.en: You know, it's like in South Park, when they say, you know, freedom isn't free.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像《南方公园》里说的，自由不是免费的。

sentences.en: It costs $1.05 or whatever.
sentences.zh: 它要花1.05美元还是什么的。

sentences.en: But it's pretty cheap.
sentences.zh: 但它相当便宜。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: It's low-cost freedom.
sentences.zh: 这是低成本的自由。

sentences.en: I got a couple more questions for you.
sentences.zh: 我还有几个问题要问你。

sentences.en: You're headed back to Texas after this to launch the Cybertruck.
sentences.zh: 你之后要回德克萨斯州去发布Cybertruck。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's going to be a big launch.
sentences.zh: 这将是一场盛大的发布会。

sentences.en: But I wanted to ask you right now more broadly just about the car business and what you see actually happening.
sentences.zh: 但我现在想更广泛地问你关于汽车行业以及你所看到的实际情况。

sentences.en: And specifically, the government put in place lots of policies, as you know, to try to encourage more Evs.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，正如你所知，政府出台了许多政策来鼓励更多电动汽车。

sentences.en: And one of the things that's happened uniquely is you have now a lot of car companies saying, actually, this is too ambitious for us.
sentences.zh: 发生的一件独特的事情是，现在有很多汽车公司说，实际上，这对我们来说太雄心勃勃了。

sentences.en: These plans are too ambitious.
sentences.zh: 这些计划太激进了。

sentences.en: 4,000 dealers, I don't know if you saw it just yesterday, sent a letter to the White House saying, this has gone too far.
sentences.zh: 4000家经销商，不知道你昨天有没有看到，他们给白宫写了一封信，说这太过分了。

sentences.en: You're going too far.
sentences.zh: 你们做得太过火了。

sentences.en: You had this...
sentences.zh: 你有这个……

sentences.en: Anti-EV?
sentences.zh: 反电动汽车？

sentences.en: It was, this is going too fast, too far, and that there's not enough demand.
sentences.zh: 是说这进展太快、太激进，而且需求不足。

sentences.en: Underneath all of this is this idea that maybe there's not enough demand for EVs, that the American public has not bought into the...
sentences.zh: 这一切背后的想法是，也许电动汽车的需求不足，美国公众还没有接受……

sentences.en: I mean, they bought into it with your company, but they haven't bought into it broadly enough.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们接受了你们公司的产品，但还没有广泛接受。

sentences.en: Well, I think if you make a compelling electric car, people will buy it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为如果你制造出一款引人注目的电动汽车，人们就会购买它。

sentences.en: No question about it.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: I mean, electric car sales in China are gigantic.
sentences.zh: 我是说，中国的电动汽车销量巨大。

sentences.en: That's by far the biggest category.
sentences.zh: 那是目前为止最大的类别。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think that would be the...
sentences.zh: 我认为那将是……

sentences.en: You know...
sentences.zh: 你知道……

sentences.en: I mean, it's worth noting...
sentences.zh: 我是说，值得注意的是……

sentences.en: Okay, so probably the best reputation of that is that the Tesla Model Y will be the best-selling car of any kind on Earth this year.
sentences.zh: 好吧，最好的反驳可能是特斯拉Model Y今年将成为全球最畅销的任何类型的汽车。

sentences.en: Of any kind, gasoline or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 任何类型，无论是汽油车还是其他。

sentences.en: Is there another car company that you think is doing a good job with EVs?
sentences.zh: 还有哪家汽车公司你认为在电动汽车方面做得很好？

sentences.en: I mean, I think the Chinese car companies are extremely competitive.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为中国汽车公司非常有竞争力。

sentences.en: By far, our toughest competition is in China.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们最强劲的竞争对手在中国。

sentences.en: So, I mean, there's a lot of people who are out there who think that the top-ten car company is going to be Tesla, followed by nine Chinese car companies.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，有很多局外人认为前十大汽车公司将是特斯拉，后面跟着九家中国汽车公司。

sentences.en: I think they might not be wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想他们可能没说错。

sentences.en: So, China is super good at manufacturing, and the work ethic is incredible.
sentences.zh: 所以，中国在制造业方面非常出色，职业道德令人难以置信。

sentences.en: So, you know, like, if we consider different leagues of competitiveness at Tesla, we consider the Chinese league to be the most competitive.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，如果我们考虑特斯拉在不同竞争水平的联赛，我们认为中国联赛是最具竞争力的。

sentences.en: And, by the way, we do very well in China, because our China team is the best China team.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我们在中国做得很好，因为我们的中国团队是最好的中国团队。

sentences.en: How worried are you that the unionization effort that just took place at, well, I shouldn't say effort, but the new wages and the like at GM and Ford, that they're coming for you?
sentences.zh: 你有多担心刚刚发生的工会化努力，嗯，我不应该说是努力，而是通用和福特的新工资标准等，他们会冲着你来？

sentences.en: And they are coming for you.
sentences.zh: 而且他们确实会冲着你来。

sentences.en: What is that going to mean to you and your business?
sentences.zh: 这对你和你的生意意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I think it's generally not good to have an adversarial relationship between people online, you know, one group at the company and another group.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我认为在公司内部，在员工之间存在对抗关系通常是不好的。

sentences.en: In fact, I mean, I disagree with the idea of unions, but perhaps for a reason that is different than people may expect,
sentences.zh: 事实上，我是说，我不同意工会的想法，但原因可能与人们预期的不同，

sentences.en: which is I just don't like anything which creates kind of a lords and peasants sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 那就是我不喜欢任何制造“领主与农奴”那种关系的东西。

sentences.en: And I think the unions naturally try to create negativity in a company and create a sort of lords and peasants situation.
sentences.zh: 我认为工会自然会试图在公司内部制造负面情绪，并制造一种“领主与农奴”的局面。

sentences.en: There are many people at Tesla who have gone from working on the line to being in senior management.
sentences.zh: 特斯拉有许多人从一线工作晋升到了高级管理层。

sentences.en: There is no lords and peasants.
sentences.zh: 这里没有领主和农奴。

sentences.en: Everyone eats at the same table.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在同一张桌子上吃饭。

sentences.en: Everyone parks in the same parking lot.
sentences.zh: 每个人都停在同一个停车场。

sentences.en: You know, at GM, there's a special elevator only for senior executives.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在通用汽车，有专门为高管准备的电梯。

sentences.en: We have no such thing at Tesla.
sentences.zh: 我们在特斯拉没有这种东西。

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，

sentences.en: and the thing is that I actually know the people on the line because I worked on the line and I walked the line and I slept in the factory and I worked beside them.
sentences.zh: 问题是我确实了解一线员工，因为我曾在生产线上工作，我走过生产线，我在工厂里睡过觉，我和他们并肩工作。

sentences.en: So I'm no stranger to them.
sentences.zh: 所以我对他们来说并不陌生。

sentences.en: And there are actually many times where I've said, well, can't we just hold a union vote?
sentences.zh: 实际上有很多次我说，好吧，我们不能直接举行工会投票吗？

sentences.en: But apparently a company is not allowed to hold a union vote.
sentences.zh: 但显然公司不允许举行工会投票。

sentences.en: So it has to be somehow called for, but the unions can't do it.
sentences.zh: 所以必须以某种方式呼吁，但工会做不到。

sentences.en: So I said, well, let's just hold a vote and see what happens.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，好吧，我们举行投票看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: The actual problem is the opposite.
sentences.zh: 实际问题恰恰相反。

sentences.en: It's not that people are trapped at Tesla building cars.
sentences.zh: 并不是人们被困在特斯拉造车。

sentences.en: The challenge is, is how do we retain great people to do the hard work of building cars when they have like six other opportunities that they can do that are easier?
sentences.zh: 挑战在于，当他们有六个其他更轻松的机会时，我们如何留住优秀的人才来从事造车这项艰苦的工作？

sentences.en: That's the actual difficulty is, is that building cars is hard work and, and, and there are much easier jobs.
sentences.zh: 这才是真正的困难，造车是艰苦的工作，而且有容易得多的工作。

sentences.en: And I just want to say that I'm incredibly appreciative of those who build cars and they know it, you know, so there's, there's, I don't know, maybe there will be unionized.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，我非常感谢那些造车的人，他们知道这一点，所以，我不知道，也许他们会加入工会。

sentences.en: If I say like, if Tesla gets unionized, it will be because we deserve it and we failed in some way.
sentences.zh: 如果我说，如果特斯拉被工会化了，那是因为我们活该，我们在某些方面失败了。

sentences.en: But we, we, we, we certainly try hard to, you know, ensure the prosperity of everyone.
sentences.zh: 但我们当然会努力确保每个人的繁荣。

sentences.en: We give everyone stock options.
sentences.zh: 我们给每个人股票期权。

sentences.en: We've, we've made many people who are just working the line who didn't even know what stocks were.
sentences.zh: 我们让许多甚至不知道什么是股票的一线员工，

sentences.en: We've made the millionaires.
sentences.zh: 我们让他们成了百万富翁。

sentences.en: Um, so we're going to run out of time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们的时间快到了。

sentences.en: Final couple of quick, quick questions.
sentences.zh: 最后几个简短的问题。

sentences.en: When do you have the time to tweet or to post?
sentences.zh: 你什么时候有时间发推文或发帖？

sentences.en: How do I, I, I, I actually think about it all the time.
sentences.zh: 我怎么……我一直在想这个问题。

sentences.en: As I said, I use it bathroom sometimes.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，我有时在洗手间用。

sentences.en: I use it all the time.
sentences.zh: 我一直都在用。

sentences.en: Meaning if we were to, if we were to open up our phones and look at the screen time, what does yours look like?
sentences.zh: 意思是如果我们打开手机看屏幕使用时间，你的看起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, about every three hours I make a trip to the lavatory.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大约每三个小时我就去一次洗手间。

sentences.en: Um, that's the only time you do this?
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是你做这件事的唯一时间吗？

sentences.en: Seems like you're on there a lot.
sentences.zh: 看起来你经常在上面。

sentences.en: Um, no, I mean, I, there'll be like brief moments between meetings.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，我是说，会议之间会有短暂的空隙。

sentences.en: Um, I mean, it's not, obviously I've, I've like 17 jobs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，显然我有17份工作。

sentences.en: So, you know, and, um, no, no, I guess technically it's work at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，嗯，不，不，我想现在这在技术上算是工作。

sentences.en: It is, but I, but I'm thinking just in terms of your mind share.
sentences.zh: 确实是，但我是在想你的心智份额。

sentences.en: I mean, by the way, there's a lot of people who should be working who are on, who are on this app.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，有很多应该工作的人都在这个应用上。

sentences.en: Technically posting on Twitter is, or X is work.
sentences.zh: 在Twitter或X上发帖在技术上就是工作。

sentences.en: It does count as work.
sentences.zh: 这确实算作工作。

sentences.en: So that's, you know, there's that.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，就是这样。

sentences.en: Um, uh, but no, I mean, I, I think I'm on, well, I guess usually probably I'm on for longer than I think I am.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我认为我……嗯，我想通常我在线的时间可能比我想象的要长。

sentences.en: But what, I know, but do you think that's five hours a day, four hours?
sentences.zh: 但是什么，我知道，但你认为那是每天五个小时，四个小时？

sentences.en: If you look at the screen time of like a number of hours per week, sometimes that's a scary number.
sentences.zh: 如果你看每周的小时数，有时那是一个可怕的数字。

sentences.en: Um, it's probably, I don't know, it's a little over an hour a day or something like that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，可能是，我不知道，每天一个多小时之类的。

sentences.en: Just an hour a day.
sentences.zh: 每天只有一个小时。

sentences.en: If we really looked at this together, do you have your phone with you?
sentences.zh: 如果我们一起看看，你带手机了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 带了。

sentences.en: You want to look?
sentences.zh: 你想看看吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: You ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Screen time.
sentences.zh: 屏幕使用时间。

sentences.en: It's general.
sentences.zh: 这是总的。

sentences.en: Screen time.
sentences.zh: 屏幕使用时间。

sentences.en: Sometimes there's a scary number, but.
sentences.zh: 有时有一个可怕的数字，但是。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: That's why I, I thought, uh.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我……我想，呃。

sentences.en: Uh, I just got a new phone.
sentences.zh: 呃，我刚换了新手机。

sentences.en: So I think this is not accurate because it says it's one minute.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这不准确，因为它说只有一分钟。

sentences.en: Pretty sure it's more than that.
sentences.zh: 我很确定不止这些。

sentences.en: Wait, it's over the week.
sentences.zh: 等等，这是这一周的。

sentences.en: Ah, there we go.
sentences.zh: 啊，在这儿。

sentences.en: Yeah, go, go to, go to the week.
sentences.zh: 是的，去，去，去看看这一周的。

sentences.en: Okay, so it's still wrong.
sentences.zh: 好吧，它还是错的。

sentences.en: It's, it's more than four minutes.
sentences.zh: 它……它不止四分钟。

sentences.en: I just got a new phone.
sentences.zh: 我刚换了新手机。

sentences.en: So this is not accurate.
sentences.zh: 所以这不准确。

sentences.en: It literally says four minutes.
sentences.zh: 它上面写着四分钟。

sentences.en: New phone.
sentences.zh: 新手机。

sentences.en: Tim Cook said any of that phone?
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·库克说过那手机的什么吗？

sentences.en: New phone, new phone, who does?
sentences.zh: 新手机，新手机，谁知道呢？

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你知道。

sentences.en: I should ask, by the way, because I just mentioned Tim Cook.
sentences.zh: 顺便问一下，因为我刚才提到了蒂姆·库克。

sentences.en: Do you feel like you're going to have to have a battle with him eventually?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你最终会不得不和他有一场较量吗？

sentences.en: Is that, is that the next fight?
sentences.zh: 那是……那是下一场战斗吗？

sentences.en: I mean.
sentences.zh: 我是说。

sentences.en: Over the app store?
sentences.zh: 关于应用商店？

sentences.en: The idea of making a phone.
sentences.zh: 制造手机的想法。

sentences.en: What do you mean like?
sentences.zh: 你是指像什么？

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: Over the app store.
sentences.zh: 关于应用商店。

sentences.en: Would you ever make a phone?
sentences.zh: 你会制造手机吗？

sentences.en: Sam Altman's apparently thinking about making a phone with Johnny Hive.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·奥特曼显然在考虑和乔尼·艾维一起制造手机。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't think there's a real need to make a phone.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我不认为有制造手机的真正需求。

sentences.en: I mean, if there's a essential need to make a phone, I'll make a phone.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果有制造手机的必要需求，我会制造手机。

sentences.en: But I got a lot of fish to fry.
sentences.zh: 但我还有很多别的事要忙。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I do think there's a fundamental challenge that phone makers have at this point because you've got basically a black rectangle.
sentences.zh: 所以，我是说，我确实认为手机制造商目前面临一个根本性的挑战，因为你基本上只有一个黑色矩形。

sentences.en: You know, how do you make that better?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你怎么能让它变得更好？

sentences.en: So do you want to do that?
sentences.zh: 所以你想做那个吗？

sentences.en: What does that look like in Elon's head?
sentences.zh: 在埃隆的脑海里那是什么样子的？

sentences.en: No, that's literally, yeah, good phrase.
sentences.zh: 不，那字面意思上，是的，好词。

sentences.en: In the head, a neural link.
sentences.zh: 在脑子里，神经连接。

sentences.en: Well, there we go.
sentences.zh: 好吧，就是这样。

sentences.en: We need to touch that before it's over.
sentences.zh: 在一切结束之前，我们需要触及那个领域。

sentences.en: You know, the best interface would be a neural interface directly to your brain.
sentences.zh: 你知道，最好的交互界面应该是直接连接大脑的神经接口。

sentences.en: So that would be a neural link.
sentences.zh: 也就是所谓的神经链接（Neuralink）。

sentences.en: How far are we, do you think, from that?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们离那一步还有多远？

sentences.en: And how excited or scary does that seem to be?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这听起来是令人兴奋还是令人恐惧？

sentences.en: And we read these headlines, obviously, about monkeys who died, as you know.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们读到过关于猴子死亡的头条新闻，你也知道。

sentences.en: What should we think about that?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何看待这件事？

sentences.en: Yeah, actually, the USDA inspector who came by the neural link facilities literally said, in her entire career, she has never seen a better animal care facility.
sentences.zh: 是的，实际上，来过Neuralink设施的美国农业部检查员亲口说过，在她整个职业生涯中，从未见过比这更好的动物护理设施。

sentences.en: We are the nicest to animals that you could possibly be, even to the rats and mice, even though they did the plague and everything.
sentences.zh: 我们对动物的照顾达到了极致，即便是对那些老鼠，尽管它们曾引发过瘟疫之类的灾难。

sentences.en: So, it is like monkey paradise.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里简直是猴子的天堂。

sentences.en: So, the thing that gets conflated is that there were some terminal monkeys where, you know, this is actually several years ago, where the monkeys were about to die.
sentences.zh: 人们混淆的一点是，确实有几只处于生命末期的猴子，那是几年前的事了，当时那些猴子已经快要死了。

sentences.en: And we're like, okay, we've got an experimental device.
sentences.zh: 我们当时想，好吧，我们有一个实验性设备。

sentences.en: It's the kind of thing we should only put on a monkey that's about to die.
sentences.zh: 这种设备我们只应该用在快要死去的猴子身上。

sentences.en: And then, you know, now the monkey died, but it didn't die because of the neural link.
sentences.zh: 所以，那只猴子确实死了，但它并不是因为Neuralink而死。

sentences.en: It died because it was, you know, at a terminal case of cancer or something like that.
sentences.zh: 它死于癌症晚期之类的疾病。

sentences.en: So, neural link has never coursed the death of a monkey.
sentences.zh: 因此，Neuralink从未导致过任何一只猴子的死亡。

sentences.en: It's the best, unless they're hiding something from me, it has never coursed the death of a monkey.
sentences.zh: 这是最好的情况，除非他们对我隐瞒了什么，否则它从未导致过猴子死亡。

sentences.en: And, in fact, we've now had monkeys with neural link implants for, like, two, three years, and they're doing great.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们现在有植入了Neuralink的猴子已经存活了两三年了，它们状况非常好。

sentences.en: So, and we've even replaced the neural link twice.
sentences.zh: 而且我们甚至已经更换过两次Neuralink设备了。

sentences.en: And we're getting ready to do the first implants in, hopefully, in a few months.
sentences.zh: 我们正准备进行首次人体植入，希望在几个月内实现。

sentences.en: The early implementations of neural link, I think, are unequivocally good.
sentences.zh: 我认为Neuralink的早期应用无疑是有益的。

sentences.en: Speaking of the double-edged sword, I think these early implementations are single-edged sword
sentences.zh: 说到双刃剑，我认为这些早期应用更像是单刃剑，

sentences.en: because the first implementations will be to enable people who have lost the brain-body connection

sentences.en: And we should have proof of that in a human, hopefully, in a few months.

sentences.en: So, in the next application, after the sort of those dealing with tetraplegics and quadriplegics is going to be vision.

sentences.en: Vision is the next thing.

sentences.en: So, it's like if somebody has lost both eyes or the optic nerve has failed, basically where they have no possibility of having sort of some ocular correction,
sentences.zh: 如果有人双目失明或视神经受损，基本上没有任何眼科矫正的可能，

sentences.en: Two final questions, and then we're going to end this conversation, which I think has taken everybody inside the mind of Elon Musk today.

sentences.en: Not as well as a neural link.

sentences.en: And I asked this question of Pete Buttigieg, transportation secretary.

sentences.en: It's actually something you retweeted, so I wanted to ask you the same question.
sentences.zh: 这其实是你转发过的内容，所以我很想问你同样的问题。

sentences.en: There's a big question about autonomous vehicles and the safety of them.
sentences.zh: 关于自动驾驶汽车及其安全性，存在一个巨大的疑问。

sentences.en: But there's also a question about when it will be politically palatable in this country for people to die in cars that are controlled by computers,
sentences.zh: 但还有一个问题是，在这个国家，人们何时才能在政治上接受死于电脑控制的汽车中，

sentences.en: which is, say, we have 35,000, 40,000 deaths every year in this country.
sentences.zh: 毕竟我们国家每年有3.5万到4万人死于车祸。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If you could bring that number down to 10,000, 5,000, that might be a great thing.
sentences.zh: 如果你能把这个数字降到1万或5000，那可能是一件伟大的事情。

sentences.en: But do we think that the country will accept the idea that 5,000 people, that your family might have perished in a vehicle as a result not of a human making a mistake,
sentences.zh: 但我们认为这个国家会接受这样的事实吗：如果你的家人因为电脑而非人为失误而死于车祸，

sentences.en: but of a computer?
sentences.zh: 你会接受吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, first of all, humans are terrible drivers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，人类是非常糟糕的司机。

sentences.en: So people text and drive.
sentences.zh: 人们会边开车边发短信。

sentences.en: They drink and drive.
sentences.zh: 他们会酒后驾车。

sentences.en: They get into arguments.
sentences.zh: 他们会在车里吵架。

sentences.en: They, you know, they do all sorts of things in cars that they should not do.
sentences.zh: 他们会在车里做各种不该做的事情。

sentences.en: So it's actually remarkable that there are not more deaths than there are.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在的死亡人数没有更多，其实已经很令人惊讶了。

sentences.en: What we'll find with computer driving is, I think, probably an order of magnitude reduction in deaths.
sentences.zh: 我认为，电脑驾驶将使死亡人数减少一个数量级。

sentences.en: I think now, and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在，美国的人均死亡率其实远低于世界其他地区。

sentences.en: has actually far fewer deaths per capita than the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 如果放眼全球，我认为每年因交通事故死亡的人数接近一百万。

sentences.en: If you go worldwide, I think there's something close to a million deaths per year due to automotive accidents.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为电脑驾驶可能会将这个数字降低90%甚至更多。

sentences.en: So I think computer driving will probably drop that by 90% or more.
sentences.zh: 它不会是完美的，但会比现在好10倍。

sentences.en: It won't be perfect, but it'll be 10 times better.
sentences.zh: 你认为公众会接受吗？

sentences.en: And do you think that the public will accept that?
sentences.zh: 你认为政府会接受吗？

sentences.en: Do you think the government will accept that?
sentences.zh: 嗯，当数据足够庞大时，这会成为一个显而易见的事实，以至于无法否认。

sentences.en: Well, in large numbers, it will simply be so obviously true that it really cannot be denied.
sentences.zh: 那你怎么看？

sentences.en: And what do you think?
sentences.zh: 我知道我们之前谈过时间表，也知道有人批评你发布的时间表可能尚未实现。

sentences.en: I know we've talked about the timeline before, and I know people have criticized you for putting out timelines that may not have come true just yet.
sentences.zh: 但你觉得真实情况会是怎样？

sentences.en: But what do you think it really is?
sentences.zh: 顺便问一下，你会不会有时对自己说，哦，我不该那样说？

sentences.en: And by the way, do you feel like, do you ever say to yourself, oh, I shouldn't have said that?
sentences.zh: 当然，肯定会。

sentences.en: Sure, of course.
sentences.zh: 等等，我不该那样说。

sentences.en: Wait, I shouldn't have said that.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我的意思是，我对时间表持乐观态度，我是天生乐观的。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I mean, I'm optimistic about, I mean, I think I'm, like, naturally optimistic about timescales.
sentences.zh: 如果我不天生乐观，我就不会做我现在做的这些事了。

sentences.en: And if I was not naturally optimistic, I wouldn't be doing the things that I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 说实话，如果我没有某种病态的乐观，我肯定不会去创办火箭公司或汽车公司。

sentences.en: I mean, I certainly wouldn't have sought a rocket company or, like, a car company if I didn't have some sort of pathological optimism, frankly.
sentences.zh: 正如你指出的，很多人说我会失败。

sentences.en: So, as you pointed out, many people said they would fail.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我当时也同意他们的看法。

sentences.en: And, in fact, actually, I agreed with them.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，它很可能会失败。

sentences.en: I said, yes, it probably will fail.
sentences.zh: 他们就说，嗯，好吧。

sentences.en: And they're like, hmm, okay.
sentences.zh: 但我认为SpaceX和特斯拉在创立时成功的几率不到10%。

sentences.en: But I thought SpaceX and Tesla had less than a 10% chance of success when we started them.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，无论如何，关于自动驾驶，我一直很乐观。

sentences.en: So, yeah, anyway, but the self-driving thing is, I've been optimistic about it.
sentences.zh: 我们确实取得了很大进展。

sentences.en: We've certainly made a lot of progress.
sentences.zh: 如果有人尝试过使用完全自动驾驶测试版（FSD Beta），就会发现每年的进步都是巨大的。

sentences.en: If anybody has tried, has been using the sort of full self-driving beta, the progress is, you know, every year has been substantial.
sentences.zh: 现在它确实已经达到了在大多数地方无需人工干预就能把你从一个地方送到另一个地方的程度。

sentences.en: It's really now at the point where, in most places, it'll take you from one place to another with no interventions.

sentences.en: And the data is unequivocal that supervised full self-driving is somewhere around four times safer, maybe more, than just human driving by themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以，我确实能看到它的到来。

sentences.en: So, you know, I can certainly see it coming.
sentences.zh: 真的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Actually, really.
sentences.zh: 但你认为还需要五到十年吗？

sentences.en: But you think it's another five or 10 years?
sentences.zh: 人们是这么说的。

sentences.en: I mean, people say.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不，绝对不是，绝对不是。

sentences.en: No, no, no, definitely not, definitely not.

sentences.zh: 这也是人们对此提出的另一个问题。

sentences.zh: 我最终总是会交付成果的。
